articles.title: ‘My death was reported in Rolling Stone’: how the Zombies made Time of the Season

One group said they were the originals but with a new singer – because I’d been killed in a car crash’ Our first single, She’s Not There, was one of the first songs I wrote, when I was 18. It remained our only hit in the UK by the time we recorded our second album, Odessey and Oracle, in 1967 – this was only three years later but it felt like a lifetime. We’d recently signed to CBS and had been given £1,000, which even then was not a huge amount of money. We recorded pretty quickly in a few sessions spread over six months, producing ourselves for the first time. Continue reading...
